params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $runnerDir=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'actions-runner-heaven'; $listeners=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'Runner.Listener.exe' -and $_.ExecutablePath -like "$runnerDir*" }); Write-Output ('BEFORE_LISTENERS='+$listeners.Count); foreach($p in $listeners){ Write-Output ('KILL_TREE_PID='+$p.ProcessId); & taskkill.exe /PID $p.ProcessId /T /F | Write-Output }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; $runCmd=Join-Path $runnerDir 'run.cmd'; $cmdExe=Join-Path ([Environment]::SystemDirectory) 'cmd.exe'; Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden -FilePath $cmdExe -ArgumentList ('/d /c ""{0}""' -f $runCmd) -WorkingDirectory $runnerDir | Out-Null; Start-Sleep -Seconds 7; $after=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'Runner.Listener.exe' -and $_.ExecutablePath -like "$runnerDir*" }); Write-Output ('AFTER_LISTENERS='+$after.Count); $after | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 | Write-Output; if($after.Count -ne 1){throw "Expected exactly one listener after recycle, found $($after.Count)"}; Write-Output 'ACTIONS_RUNNER_RECYCLED'
